ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens, dark green and light green leaves with some reddish-purple tinged leaves, torn and ruffled, moist with slight dressing sheen, covering roughly 25-30% of the plate on the left side, about 2 cm thick in the mound | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin pale yellow-green shredded strands (possibly sprouts or shredded vegetable), fine and wispy, sitting on top of the greens near the center-left, about 5 cm across | 8
ITEM 3 | Green beans, whole and slender, bright green with some darker spots, lying in a loose pile across the top center of the plate, about 8-10 cm long each, roughly 6-8 pieces visible | 35
ITEM 4 | Cooked grain mixture of small tan/golden round grains with orange-red diced pieces and bits of green, moist and clumping, mounded in the upper right area about 7 cm across, 1.5 cm high | 50
ITEM 5 | Pale cream-colored cubes or chunks, firm with slightly translucent edges and soft-looking surfaces, scattered among the grains in the upper right, roughly 1-2 cm each | 20
ITEM 6 | Small pieces of pale green-yellow sliced vegetable with soft texture and light browning at edges, scattered within the grain mixture upper right | 10
ITEM 7 | Thin dark brown sauce or dressing residue smudges and droplets on the plate rim and beside the greens, glossy, low volume | 5
